body:
GitHub beamfall/corvint#776, filed by the owner 2026-10-11. 

## Problem
`corvint-playwright-minimize` minimises suite-interaction *failures* (predecessor sets that break a test); it does not find redundant steps. Large E2E suites commonly repeat the same UI navigation prefix (log in through the form, open menu, click section, click tab) before the step under test, multiplying run time and flake surface even when a deep link or stored session would reach the same state.

## Proposal
`corvint test-plan prefixes --map FILE [--ledger FILE] [--tests FILE]...` (read-only): for each spec, derive the ordered screen/edge sequence from the map's test-sequence edges, page-object calls and observed traces; compute shared prefixes across specs; flag each test whose prefix (a) only crosses edges already PROVEN elsewhere and (b) ends on a screen with a FRESH deep-linkable template, with a suggested replacement (`goto(template with params)` or a session fixture), and the estimated saved steps.

## Acceptance criteria
- Output lists `{test, prefix_edges, proven_by, entry_template, saved_steps}`; tests with UNKNOWN joins abstain with reason.
- A prefix is never flagged if any edge in it is the test's own assertion target or carries a state change (`changes` non-empty / write effect class).
- `--check` mode exits 1 when a new test introduces a flagged prefix (lint gate).
